sourceTitle: The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
originalTitle: The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: Across the EU, businesses are expanding how they use AI through agentic tools. People are moving beyond asking questions to using agents to carry out tasks from planning through completion. Our latest report from OpenAI Economic Research examines how agentic use is growing across enterprises and small businesses, focusing on differences in usage intensity and the kinds of work people do with ChatGPT.
blocks.en: Across the EU, businesses are expanding how they use AI through agentic tools. People are moving beyond asking questions to using agents to carry out tasks from planning through completion. Our latest report from OpenAI Economic Research examines how agentic use is growing across enterprises and small businesses, focusing on differences in usage intensity and the kinds of work people do with ChatGPT.
blocks.zh: 欧盟各地的企业正借助智能体工具，拓展 AI 的应用方式。人们不再只是向 AI 提问，而是开始使用智能体执行任务，贯穿从规划到完成的全过程。OpenAI 经济研究团队的最新报告考察了大型企业和小企业的智能体使用增长情况，重点分析使用强度的差异，以及人们借助 ChatGPT 完成的工作类型。

blocks.text: We have found that, among ChatGPT Enterprise customers, agentic use already represents a substantial share of activity. In our EU sample, Codex and ChatGPT Work now account for more than half of output tokens.
blocks.en: We have found that, among ChatGPT Enterprise customers, agentic use already represents a substantial share of activity. In our EU sample, Codex and ChatGPT Work now account for more than half of output tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们发现，在 ChatGPT Enterprise 客户中，智能体使用已占据相当大的使用份额。在我们的欧盟样本中，Codex 和 ChatGPT 工作目前贡献了超过一半的输出 Token。

blocks.text: This analysis defines small or medium businesses as businesses with 200 or fewer associated users.
blocks.en: This analysis defines small or medium businesses as businesses with 200 or fewer associated users.
blocks.zh: 注：本分析将关联用户数不超过 200 人的企业定义为中小企业。

blocks.text: The agentic shift extends to small and medium businesses. Since May 2026, weekly active users of Codex and ChatGPT Work among EU small and medium businesses grew more than eightfold, with growth across every member state.
blocks.en: The agentic shift extends to small and medium businesses. Since May 2026, weekly active users of Codex and ChatGPT Work among EU small and medium businesses grew more than eightfold, with growth across every member state.
blocks.zh: 向智能体的转变也延伸到了中小企业。自 2026 年 5 月以来，欧盟中小企业中 Codex 和 ChatGPT 工作的周活跃用户数已增至原来的八倍以上，所有成员国均实现了增长。

blocks.text: But we also found that the EU’s adoption of agentic AI is far from uniform. Among the ChatGPT Enterprise accounts in our sample, the share of output tokens generated through Codex and ChatGPT Work ranged from 22% in Slovenia to 85% in Lithuania. The differences across countries extends beyond the intensity of agentic use. The kinds of work people bring to ChatGPT also vary across countries.
blocks.en: But we also found that the EU’s adoption of agentic AI is far from uniform. Among the ChatGPT Enterprise accounts in our sample, the share of output tokens generated through Codex and ChatGPT Work ranged from 22% in Slovenia to 85% in Lithuania. The differences across countries extends beyond the intensity of agentic use. The kinds of work people bring to ChatGPT also vary across countries.
blocks.zh: 但我们也发现，智能体 AI 在欧盟的采用程度很不均衡。在样本中的 ChatGPT Enterprise 账户中，通过 Codex 和 ChatGPT 工作生成的输出 Token 占比，最低为斯洛文尼亚的 22%，最高为立陶宛的 85%。各国之间的差异不仅体现在智能体使用强度上。人们交给 ChatGPT 处理的工作类型也因国家而异。

blocks.text: Frontier firms are defined as the top 10% of firms by output tokens per active user. Sample includes only ChatGPT Enterprise and Business accounts.
blocks.en: Frontier firms are defined as the top 10% of firms by output tokens per active user. Sample includes only ChatGPT Enterprise and Business accounts.
blocks.zh: 领先企业指按每位活跃用户输出 Token 数排名前 10% 的企业。注：样本仅包含 ChatGPT Enterprise 和 ChatGPT Business 账户。

blocks.text: The takeaway is that EU frontier firms use AI much more intensively than typical EU firms, but still trail firms at the global frontier. In September, frontier firms in the EU generated more than four times as many output tokens per active user as typical EU firms. Even so, frontier firms outside the EU generated more than twice as many output tokens per active user as frontier EU firms. EU-based firms also represented only 10% of the frontier firms globally, which is low considering that the EU accounts for a higher share of registered companies globally.
blocks.en: The takeaway is that EU frontier firms use AI much more intensively than typical EU firms, but still trail firms at the global frontier. In September, frontier firms in the EU generated more than four times as many output tokens per active user as typical EU firms. Even so, frontier firms outside the EU generated more than twice as many output tokens per active user as frontier EU firms. EU-based firms also represented only 10% of the frontier firms globally, which is low considering that the EU accounts for a higher share of registered companies globally.
blocks.zh: 由此可见，欧盟领先企业的 AI 使用强度远高于欧盟一般企业，但仍落后于全球领先水平。9 月，欧盟领先企业的每位活跃用户输出 Token 数超过欧盟一般企业的四倍。即便如此，欧盟以外领先企业的每位活跃用户输出 Token 数仍超过欧盟领先企业的两倍。此外，总部位于欧盟的企业仅占全球领先企业的 10%。考虑到欧盟注册企业数量在全球所占的比例更高，这一占比偏低。

blocks.text: These figures reveal a substantial gap in how intensively businesses use AI. As agentic capabilities advance, the EU’s opportunity is to turn broader adoption into deeper use, stronger businesses, higher productivity and meaningful benefits for workers. Closing that gap means helping businesses move beyond experimentation, giving workers the skills and confidence to use AI, and making advanced capabilities more accessible and affordable.
blocks.en: These figures reveal a substantial gap in how intensively businesses use AI. As agentic capabilities advance, the EU’s opportunity is to turn broader adoption into deeper use, stronger businesses, higher productivity and meaningful benefits for workers. Closing that gap means helping businesses move beyond experimentation, giving workers the skills and confidence to use AI, and making advanced capabilities more accessible and affordable.
blocks.zh: 这些数据揭示了企业在 AI 使用强度上的显著差距。随着智能体能力不断提升，欧盟有机会在 AI 广泛普及的基础上深化应用，增强企业实力、提高生产力，并为劳动者带来切实的益处。要缩小这一差距，就需要帮助企业迈出试验阶段，让劳动者具备使用 AI 的技能和信心，并让先进能力更易获取、更可负担。

blocks.text: “Europe is now in a new era of AI, with tools that can carry out tasks for people. More than half of the AI use among our EU enterprise and business customers now involves these tools, and the number of small business users has grown 8x across the region. Yet there is still plenty of room for AI use to grow across the EU. Giving people the tools, skills and confidence to use AI well will help build stronger businesses and growing economies, with benefits felt across Europe.”
blocks.en: “Europe is now in a new era of AI, with tools that can carry out tasks for people. More than half of the AI use among our EU enterprise and business customers now involves these tools, and the number of small business users has grown 8x across the region. Yet there is still plenty of room for AI use to grow across the EU. Giving people the tools, skills and confidence to use AI well will help build stronger businesses and growing economies, with benefits felt across Europe.”
blocks.zh: “欧洲如今已进入 AI 的新时代，工具能够代替人们执行任务。我们在欧盟的企业和商业客户中，超过一半的 AI 使用已经涉及这些工具，而整个地区的小企业用户数量增长到了原来的八倍。不过，AI 在欧盟仍有很大的增长空间。为人们提供工具、技能以及用好 AI 的信心，将有助于增强企业实力、促进经济增长，让欧洲各地都能从中受益。”
